paper.prompt:
Create a distinct blank parchment sheet for an interactive medieval-inspired private commemorative scroll, using the SINGLE supplied reference as the sole material and ageing quality standard. Preserve its strong tangible old warm ivory and ochre, crisp fine irregular skin-membrane grain, varied rubbed thinning, settled warm age in pressure creases, broad incomplete old tide marks and contact-darkened areas. Match the reference's actual degree of visible age throughout the sheet; do not clean, bleach, smooth, flatten or homogenize the central writing field. The older first-chapter reference is the material benchmark, not a style to modernize. This is a genuinely different individual sheet with its own history, not a mirror, rotation or recolour of this one.

Show ONE fully blank whole sheet, perfectly straight-on orthographic flat material cutout, portrait 5:7, complete silhouette with narrow transparent perimeter. Mostly straight hand-trimmed sides; shallow irregular deviations, an oblique small upper-right cut, a tiny nick midway down the left edge, slightly slanted bottom, long intact edge stretches interrupted by local abrasion. Retain supple skin thickness, fine scraping and irregular natural grain rather than decorative fabric pattern. Design an old broad shallow diagonal pressure fold crossing from about 26 percent of height at the left to 39 percent at the right; a second shallow, uneven nearly horizontal pressure fold across about 70 percent of the height. These are flattened flexible membrane creases with thin dark settled valleys and worn lips, not white raised ridges. Include the reference's rich pale amber tide-like age variation and handled wear in some central areas as well as selected edges. The old marks must remain visibly legible when the whole page is small. A real aged surface, neither immaculate modern stationery nor a dirty rotten object. No mould, mildew or black spot clusters; do not remove ordinary old water/contact marks in an attempt to avoid mould.

Neutral diffuse material light, no shiny highlight, cast shadow, halo, tabletop or scenery. Actual RGBA: outside silhouette transparent; inside opaque. NO text, pseudo-writing, lettering, numerals, ornaments, border design, seal, illustration, stitches, wax or rods. No burnt rim, evenly distressed four sides, modern rounded corners, fuzzy grain, glossy leather or uniform grunge overlay. Material fidelity and convincing old use take priority over exact nick or fold positions.

miniature.prompt:
An original fine medieval-inspired manuscript miniature, a small transparent ink-and-wash spot illustration to accompany a personal commemoration of an English learning project's beginning. The central idea is an open book facing the everyday world outside a window. Horizontal group about 1.7:1, fully visible, generous transparent margins, no rectangular picture field. A modest open parchment book occupies a little over half the grouping width on a short worn narrow timber sill. Credible curved paired leaves, fine unequal layered page edges, one slightly lifted leaf; pages have NO writing. Only a fragment of an old timber window frame and partly open wooden shutter behind its left side, never enough to form a picture frame. In the airy opening, three or four sparse blue-grey rain strokes. A single small heel of bread with a little exposed crumb at the book's lower right, less than one fifth the grouping width. Book first, rain and bread subordinate, not a still-life feast. Space around and between the subjects is transparent.

Intentional iron-gall brown quill lines, varying pressure, fine precise hatching and sparse dry pigment, subdued ivory/umber material washes with a little wheat ochre and very slight blue-grey. Careful observed objects with clear physical boundaries, an eloquent tiny manuscript drawing, legible silhouettes and fine detail, subdued handcrafted character rather than generic glossy AI illustration. The sill fragment ends naturally and the architectural strokes taper away. True alpha, no beige paper backing, wall, sky rectangle, whole room or background cast shadow. No glowing light, ornamental frame, heraldry, rays, sunburst, gold, large scenery, people, hands, decorative foliage, plants, seeds, river, map, dragon, electronics, sound icons or modern book logo. Absolutely no letters, pseudo-writing, captions, numerals or signature. This is only an independent small illustration; all real text is typeset separately.
